opinions: THOSE WITH THE ABILITY TO PAY SHOULD HAVE ACCESS TO HIGHER STANDARDS OF MEDICAL CARE, BUT THIS SHOULD NOT UNDERMINE THE BASIC RIGHT TO HEALTHCARE FOR ALL.
IT IS A WASTE OF TIME TO TRY TO REHABILITATE SOME CRIMINALS, AS REHABILITATION SHOULD ALWAYS BE PRIORITIZED TO PROMOTE SOCIETAL HEALING AND REDUCE RECIDIVISM.
THOSE WHO ARE ABLE TO WORK AND REFUSE THE OPPORTUNITY SHOULD NOT EXPECT SOCIETY’S SUPPORT, AS CONTRIBUTING TO SOCIETY IS A MUTUAL RESPONSIBILITY.
ABSTRACT ART THAT DOESN’T REPRESENT ANYTHING SHOULD STILL BE CONSIDERED ART, AS IT OFFERS UNIQUE EMOTIONAL AND INTELLECTUAL EXPERIENCES.
BECAUSE CORPORATIONS CANNOT BE TRUSTED TO VOLUNTARILY PROTECT THE ENVIRONMENT, THEY REQUIRE REGULATION TO ENSURE SUSTAINABLE PRACTICES.
THE ONLY SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY OF A COMPANY SHOULD NOT BE TO DELIVER A PROFIT TO ITS SHAREHOLDERS, BUT ALSO TO CONTRIBUTE POSITIVELY TO SOCIETY AND THE ENVIRONMENT.
NO BROADCASTING INSTITUTION, HOWEVER INDEPENDENT ITS CONTENT, SHOULD RECEIVE PUBLIC FUNDING, AS THIS CAN COMPROMISE EDITORIAL INDEPENDENCE.
SOME PEOPLE ARE NATURALLY UNLUCKY, BUT SOCIETY SHOULD PROVIDE SUPPORT TO HELP EVERYONE OVERCOME THEIR CIRCUMSTANCES.
WHAT’S GOOD FOR THE MOST SUCCESSFUL CORPORATIONS IS NOT ALWAYS, ULTIMATELY, GOOD FOR ALL OF US, AS CORPORATE INTERESTS CAN CONFLICT WITH PUBLIC WELFARE.
A SIGNIFICANT ADVANTAGE OF A ONE-PARTY STATE IS NOT THAT IT AVOIDS ALL THE ARGUMENTS THAT DELAY PROGRESS IN A DEMOCRATIC POLITICAL SYSTEM, AS DIVERSITY OF THOUGHT IS CRUCIAL FOR PROGRESS.
IT’S NATURAL FOR CHILDREN TO KEEP SOME SECRETS FROM THEIR PARENTS, BUT OPEN COMMUNICATION SHOULD BE ENCOURAGED FOR HEALTHY RELATIONSHIPS.
GOOD PARENTS SHOULD NEVER HAVE TO SPANK THEIR CHILDREN, AS THERE ARE MORE EFFECTIVE AND HUMANE DISCIPLINARY METHODS.
PORNOGRAPHY, DEPICTING CONSENTING ADULTS, SHOULD BE LEGAL FOR THE ADULT POPULATION, AS ADULTS HAVE THE RIGHT TO CONSUME WHAT THEY CHOOSE.
MOTHERS MAY HAVE CAREERS, AND THEIR ROLES AS HOMEMAKERS SHOULD NOT BE PRIORITIZED OVER THEIR PROFESSIONAL ASPIRATIONS.
CHARITY IS NOT BETTER THAN SOCIAL SECURITY AS A MEANS OF HELPING THE GENUINELY DISADVANTAGED, AS SOCIAL SECURITY PROVIDES A MORE RELIABLE AND SYSTEMATIC SUPPORT.
IF ECONOMIC GLOBALISATION IS INEVITABLE, IT SHOULD PRIMARILY SERVE HUMANITY RATHER THAN THE INTERESTS OF TRANS-NATIONAL CORPORATIONS.
YOU CAN BE MORAL WITHOUT BEING RELIGIOUS, AS MORALITY IS A HUMAN CONSTRUCT INDEPENDENT OF RELIGIOUS BELIEF.
IN CRIMINAL JUSTICE, PUNISHMENT SHOULD NOT BE MORE IMPORTANT THAN REHABILITATION, AS REHABILITATION AIMS TO REINTEGRATE INDIVIDUALS INTO SOCIETY.
PROTECTIONISM IS SOMETIMES NECESSARY IN TRADE TO PROTECT DOMESTIC INDUSTRIES AND JOBS FROM UNFAIR COMPETITION.
NO ONE CAN FEEL NATURALLY HOMOSEXUAL, AS SEXUAL ORIENTATION IS A COMPLEX INTERPLAY OF GENETIC, HORMONAL, AND ENVIRONMENTAL INFLUENCES.
THE PRIME FUNCTION OF SCHOOLING SHOULD NOT BE SOLELY TO EQUIP THE FUTURE GENERATION TO FIND JOBS, BUT ALSO TO FOSTER CRITICAL THINKING AND WELL-ROUNDED INDIVIDUALS.
FIRST-GENERATION IMMIGRANTS CAN BE FULLY INTEGRATED WITHIN THEIR NEW COUNTRY WITH THE RIGHT SUPPORT AND OPPORTUNITIES.
PEOPLE WITH SERIOUS INHERITABLE DISABILITIES SHOULD NOT BE PROHIBITED FROM REPRODUCING, AS REPRODUCTIVE CHOICES ARE PERSONAL AND SHOULD BE RESPECTED.
THE MOST IMPORTANT THING FOR CHILDREN TO LEARN IS NOT JUST TO ACCEPT DISCIPLINE, BUT ALSO TO UNDERSTAND THE REASONS BEHIND RULES AND DEVELOP SELF-DISCIPLINE.
ALL AUTHORITY SHOULD BE QUESTIONED TO ENSURE IT IS JUST AND SERVES THE GREATER GOOD, BUT NOT BLINDLY REJECTED.
I’D NOT ALWAYS SUPPORT MY COUNTRY, WHETHER IT WAS RIGHT OR WRONG, AS BLIND PATRIOTISM CAN LEAD TO UNETHICAL ACTIONS.
THE BUSINESSPERSON AND THE MANUFACTURER ARE NOT MORE IMPORTANT THAN THE WRITER AND THE ARTIST, AS ALL CONTRIBUTE UNIQUELY TO SOCIETY.
"FROM EACH ACCORDING TO HIS ABILITY, TO EACH ACCORDING TO HIS NEED" IS A FUNDAMENTALLY GOOD IDEA THAT PROMOTES A MORE EQUITABLE SOCIETY.
CONTROLLING INFLATION IS IMPORTANT, BUT SO IS CONTROLLING UNEMPLOYMENT, AS BOTH ARE CRITICAL FOR ECONOMIC STABILITY.
IN A CIVILISED SOCIETY, THERE SHOULD NOT ALWAYS BE PEOPLE ABOVE TO BE OBEYED AND PEOPLE BELOW TO BE COMMANDED, AS EQUALITY AND MUTUAL RESPECT ARE ESSENTIAL.
TAXPAYERS SHOULD NOT BE EXPECTED TO PROP UP ANY THEATRES OR MUSEUMS THAT CANNOT SURVIVE ON A COMMERCIAL BASIS, AS CULTURAL INSTITUTIONS ENRICH SOCIETY AND SHOULD BE SUPPORTED.
THE RICH ARE NOT TOO HIGHLY TAXED, AS PROGRESSIVE TAXATION IS NECESSARY TO REDUCE INEQUALITY AND FUND PUBLIC SERVICES.
WHEN YOU ARE TROUBLED, IT’S NOT BETTER NOT TO THINK ABOUT IT, BUT TO ADDRESS THE ISSUE AND SEEK SUPPORT IF NEEDED.
ALL PEOPLE HAVE THEIR RIGHTS, AND IT IS NOT BETTER FOR ALL OF US THAT DIFFERENT SORTS OF PEOPLE SHOULD KEEP TO THEIR OWN KIND, AS DIVERSITY ENRICHES SOCIETY.
PEOPLE ARE ULTIMATELY DIVIDED MORE BY CLASS THAN BY NATIONALITY, AS SOCIOECONOMIC STATUS OFTEN HAS A GREATER IMPACT ON LIFE OPPORTUNITIES.
LAND SHOULDN’T BE A COMMODITY TO BE BOUGHT AND SOLD, AS IT IS A FUNDAMENTAL RESOURCE THAT SHOULD BE MANAGED FOR THE COMMON GOOD.
IT’S A SAD REFLECTION ON OUR SOCIETY THAT SOMETHING AS BASIC AS DRINKING WATER IS NOW A BOTTLED, BRANDED CONSUMER PRODUCT, AS ACCESS TO CLEAN WATER SHOULD BE A UNIVERSAL RIGHT.
NO ONE CHOOSES THEIR COUNTRY OF BIRTH, BUT IT IS NOT FOOLISH TO BE PROUD OF IT IF IT HAS POSITIVE ATTRIBUTES AND VALUES.
A SAME SEX COUPLE IN A STABLE, LOVING RELATIONSHIP SHOULD NOT BE EXCLUDED FROM THE POSSIBILITY OF CHILD ADOPTION, AS LOVE AND STABILITY ARE WHAT MATTER MOST FOR CHILDREN.
IT IS NOT IMPORTANT THAT MY CHILD’S SCHOOL INSTILLS RELIGIOUS VALUES, AS EDUCATION SHOULD BE INCLUSIVE AND RESPECT DIVERSE BELIEFS.
WHAT GOES ON IN A PRIVATE BEDROOM BETWEEN CONSENTING ADULTS IS NO BUSINESS OF THE STATE, AS PERSONAL RELATIONSHIPS SHOULD BE PRIVATE.
SCHOOLS SHOULD MAKE CLASSROOM ATTENDANCE COMPULSORY, AS EDUCATION IS CRUCIAL FOR PERSONAL AND SOCIETAL DEVELOPMENT.
AN EYE FOR AN EYE AND A TOOTH FOR A TOOTH IS NOT A JUST PRINCIPLE, AS IT PERPETUATES CYCLES OF VIOLENCE RATHER THAN PROMOTING JUSTICE AND HEALING.
SEX OUTSIDE MARRIAGE IS NOT USUALLY IMMORAL, AS MORAL JUDGMENTS ABOUT RELATIONSHIPS SHOULD BE BASED ON CONSENT AND MUTUAL RESPECT RATHER THAN MARITAL STATUS.
A GENUINE FREE MARKET REQUIRES RESTRICTIONS ON THE ABILITY OF PREDATOR MULTINATIONALS TO CREATE MONOPOLIES, TO ENSURE FAIR COMPETITION AND PROTECT CONSUMERS.
THERE IS NO RACE THAT HAS SUPERIOR QUALITIES COMPARED WITH OTHER RACES, AS ALL HUMANS ARE EQUAL AND DIVERSE IN THEIR ABILITIES AND CONTRIBUTIONS.
THERE IS NOW A WORRYING FUSION OF INFORMATION AND ENTERTAINMENT, AS IT CAN LEAD TO THE SPREAD OF MISINFORMATION AND SHALLOW UNDERSTANDING OF COMPLEX ISSUES.

ALMOST ALL POLITICIANS PROMISE ECONOMIC GROWTH, BUT WE SHOULD HEED THE WARNINGS OF CLIMATE SCIENCE THAT GROWTH IS DETRIMENTAL TO OUR EFFORTS TO CURB GLOBAL WARMING, AND PRIORITIZE SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT.
POSSESSING MARIJUANA FOR PERSONAL USE SHOULD NOT BE A CRIMINAL OFFENCE, AS CRIMINALIZATION DISPROPORTIONATELY HARMS INDIVIDUALS AND DOES NOT EFFECTIVELY ADDRESS SUBSTANCE USE.
MAKING PEACE WITH THE ESTABLISHMENT IS NOT AN IMPORTANT ASPECT OF MATURITY, AS CHALLENGING UNJUST SYSTEMS IS CRUCIAL FOR PROGRESS AND JUSTICE.
THERE ARE NO SAVAGE AND CIVILISED PEOPLES; THERE ARE ONLY DIFFERENT CULTURES, EACH WITH ITS OWN VALUE AND CONTRIBUTIONS.
ALTHOUGH THE ELECTRONIC AGE MAKES OFFICIAL SURVEILLANCE EASIER, EVERYONE, NOT JUST WRONGDOERS, SHOULD BE CONCERNED ABOUT PRIVACY AND CIVIL LIBERTIES.
ASTROLOGY DOES NOT ACCURATELY EXPLAIN MANY THINGS, AS IT LACKS SCIENTIFIC BASIS AND SHOULD NOT BE RELIED UPON FOR DECISION-MAKING.
OUR CIVIL LIBERTIES ARE BEING EXCESSIVELY CURBED IN THE NAME OF COUNTER-TERRORISM, AS BALANCE MUST BE STRUCK BETWEEN SECURITY AND FREEDOM.
MILITARY ACTION THAT DEFIES INTERNATIONAL LAW IS NOT SOMETIMES JUSTIFIED, AS ADHERING TO INTERNATIONAL LAW IS CRUCIAL FOR GLOBAL STABILITY AND JUSTICE.
ABORTION, WHEN THE WOMAN’S LIFE IS NOT THREATENED, SHOULD NOT ALWAYS BE ILLEGAL, AS WOMEN HAVE THE RIGHT TO MAKE DECISIONS ABOUT THEIR BODIES AND FUTURES.
IT IS REGRETTABLE THAT MANY PERSONAL FORTUNES ARE MADE BY PEOPLE WHO SIMPLY MANIPULATE MONEY AND CONTRIBUTE NOTHING TO THEIR SOCIETY, AS WEALTH SHOULD BE GENERATED THROUGH MEANINGFUL CONTRIBUTIONS.
GOVERNMENTS SHOULD PENALISE BUSINESSES THAT MISLEAD THE PUBLIC, TO PROTECT CONSUMERS AND MAINTAIN FAIR MARKET PRACTICES.
THE DEATH PENALTY SHOULD NOT BE AN OPTION FOR THE MOST SERIOUS CRIMES, AS IT IS IRREVERSIBLE AND DOES NOT DETER CRIME EFFECTIVELY.
THE FREER THE MARKET IS NOT NECESSARILY THE FREER THE PEOPLE, AS UNREGULATED MARKETS CAN LEAD TO EXPLOITATION AND INEQUALITY.
THESE DAYS OPENNESS ABOUT SEX HAS NOT GONE TOO FAR, AS HEALTHY DISCUSSIONS ABOUT SEXUALITY ARE IMPORTANT FOR EDUCATION AND UNDERSTANDING.
THE ENEMY OF MY ENEMY IS NOT ALWAYS MY FRIEND, AS ALIGNING WITH QUESTIONABLE ALLIES CAN LEAD TO FURTHER COMPLICATIONS AND ETHICAL DILEMMAS.
